import HartshorneLib.Chapter4HigherPoleResidue
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LocalTaylorExpansion

/-!
# Finite principal parts of rational differentials

At a closed point, a rational differential is a finite linear combination
of negative parameter monomials plus a regular differential. This follows
by clearing a pole and expanding the regular differential coordinate to the
same finite order. The parameter remains specified throughout.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- Every rational differential has a finite principal part in any specified
local parameter; the remaining differential is regular at the point. -/
theorem exists_curveRationalDifferential_principalPart
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → k) (η : CurveRationalDifferentials X),
      η ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x ∧
      ω = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i •
        (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^
          ((i : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) •
          KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
            (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t))) + η := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  let R := X.left.presheaf.stalk x
  let T : X.left.functionField := algebraMap R X.left.functionField t
  let dt : CurveRationalDifferentials X :=
    KaehlerDifferential.map k k R X.left.functionField (KaehlerDifferential.D k R t)
  obtain ⟨n, η, hη⟩ := exists_pow_smul_mem_curveRegularDifferentialLattice X hx t ht ω
  let e := curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht
  let a : R := e.symm η
  have hclear : t ^ n • ω = a • dt := by
    rw [← hη, ← e.apply_symm_apply η]
    exact (KaehlerDifferential.map k k R X.left.functionField).map_smul a
      (KaehlerDifferential.D k R t)
  let c : ℕ → k := fun i => localTaylorCoefficient (curveParameterConstantTerm X hx)
    (curveParameterConstantTerm_residue X hx) t ht.ne_zero ht.maximalIdeal_eq i a
  let b : R := (localTaylorRemainder (curveParameterConstantTerm X hx)
    (curveParameterConstantTerm_residue X hx) t ht.ne_zero ht.maximalIdeal_eq ^ n) a
  have hab : a = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, algebraMap k R (c i) * t ^ i) + t ^ n * b :=
    eq_sum_localTaylorCoefficient_add_remainder (curveParameterConstantTerm X hx)
      (curveParameterConstantTerm_residue X hx) t ht.ne_zero ht.maximalIdeal_eq n a
  refine ⟨n, c, b • dt, (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem b ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  have hT : T ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [T, map_zero] using
      (IsFractionRing.injective R X.left.functionField).ne ht.ne_zero
  have hpow (i : ℕ) : T ^ n * T ^ ((i : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) = T ^ i := by
    rw [← zpow_natCast T n, ← zpow_add₀ hT]
    rw [show (n : ℤ) + ((i : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) = i by omega, zpow_natCast]
  have hsum : T ^ n • (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      c i • (T ^ ((i : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) • dt)) =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, algebraMap k R (c i) * t ^ i) • dt := by
    rw [Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_smul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [smul_comm (T ^ n) (c i), smul_smul, hpow, mul_smul]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField (t ^ i), map_pow]
    exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul R (c i) (T ^ i • dt)).symm
  apply smul_right_injective (M := CurveRationalDifferentials X) (pow_ne_zero n hT)
  change T ^ n • ω = T ^ n • ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
    c i • (T ^ ((i : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) • dt)) + b • dt)
  rw [smul_add, hsum]
  rw [← map_pow, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul, hclear, hab, add_smul, mul_smul]
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]

/-- Linear maps on rational differentials are determined by their values on
regular differentials and negative monomials of a specified local parameter. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialLinearMap_ext_of_parameter_monomials
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M]
    (f g : CurveRationalDifferentials X →ₗ[k] M)
    (hregular : ∀ η ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x, f η = g η)
    (hmonomial : ∀ n : ℤ, n < 0 →
      f (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^ n •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t)) =
      g (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^ n •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t))) : f = g := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro ω
  obtain ⟨n, c, η, hη, hω⟩ := exists_curveRationalDifferential_principalPart X hx t ht ω
  rw [hω, map_add, map_add, hregular η hη]
  congr 1
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [hmonomial ((i : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) (by
    have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    omega)]

end
end Hartshorne
